articles.title: Who’s to blame in the Shohei Ohtani injury saga? Everyone
articles.description: "I think if we look right now, here today, I would love to go back and put him on the IL," Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said.

articles.title: Dodgers takeaways: Ohtani’s return, Rushing’s injury and Henríquez’s emergence
articles.description: Ohtani could be back Monday, while it will be a little longer for Rushing. And Henríquez has earned a spot on Dave Roberts' trust tree.

articles.title: Josue De Paula has arrived. Here’s how he can impact the Dodgers’ stretch run
articles.description: With De Paula set to be the Dodgers' designated hitter in Shohei Ohtani's absence, he could swing his way into an impact role.
